name: The Grave Knight
summary: Melisara in Tarren Mill asks you to confront Atrexis, a necromancer raising the dead beneath Dalaran. She sees his work as an affront to the Forsaken.

sections.title: Melisara's Charge
sections.body: Melisara says Atrexis is a traitor to the Forsaken and raises an undead army beneath Dalaran. You are asked to defeat the Grave Knight for her; she cares little for the fate of the mage city, but says no one is beyond the Dark Lady's reach.

faq.answer: Atrexis is a necromancer in Dalaran whom Melisara calls the Grave Knight.
Melisara in Tarren Mill asks you to defeat Atrexis.

faq.q: Why does Melisara want Atrexis defeated?
faq.answer: Melisara says Atrexis is a traitor to the Forsaken who raises an undead army beneath Dalaran.
Atrexis is in the City of Dalaran.

angles.text: Melisara says she cares little for Dalaran's fate as she sends you after Atrexis.
Melisara calls Atrexis a traitor to the Forsaken and says his undead army defies what they stand for.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Grave Knight
